factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: 'By December 2025, bookings for the 2026 summer season were 59 percent higher than in the previous year... numerical_claims.claim: The Group served 190.9 thousand travellers, down 20.3% from 239.5 thousand in 2024, while revenue declined 16.1% to EUR 168.483 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 190.9 thousand travellers (2025), 239.5 thousand travellers (2024), EUR 168,483 thousand (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: 191 thousand travellers in 2025 (20% decrease). Main ratios table: 12M 2025 travellers: 190.9 thousand, revenue: 168,483 thousand EUR.

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit decreased by only 5.3% to EUR 19.650 million, increasing the gross margin by 1.3 percentage points to 11.66%.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 5.3% decrease, EUR 19,650 thousand, 1.3 pp increase to 11.66%
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Main ratios table: Gross profit 12M 2025: 19,650 thousand (-5.3% vs 2024). Alternative measures table: Gross profit margin 12M 2025: 11.66% (+1.3 pp vs 2024: 10.33%).

numerical_claims.claim: The operating loss narrowed to EUR 274 thousand from EUR 6.555 million, while EBITDA reached EUR 420 thousand compared with negative EUR 6.132 million in 2024.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 274 thousand loss, EUR 6,555 thousand prior loss, EUR 420 thousand EBITDA, EUR 6,132 thousand prior EBITDA loss
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of comprehensive income (12M): Operating profit 2025: (274), 2024: (6,555). EBITDA 2025: 420, 2024: (6,132).

numerical_claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA, excluding the EUR 5.7 million goodwill impairment recorded in 2024, also improved from negative EUR 449 thousand to positive EUR 420 thousand.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: EUR 5.7m impairment, negative EUR 449k to positive EUR 420k
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 5.7 million impairment, negative EUR 449 thousand to positive EUR 420 thousand
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Main ratios table footnote: Adjusted EBITDA excludes 2024 goodwill impairment of EUR 5.7 million. Main ratios table: Adjusted EBITDA 12M 2025: 420, 2024: (449).

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA was positive in the second half of 2025 at EUR 674 thousand, although adjusted EBITDA was lower than the EUR 1.116 million recorded in the second half of 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Main ratios table (H2): EBITDA 2025 H2: 674, Adjusted EBITDA 2025 H2: 674. Adjusted EBITDA 2024 H2: 1,116.

numerical_claims.claim: The annual net loss fell to EUR 1.169 million from EUR 7.604 million, and earnings per share improved from negative EUR 0.97 to negative EUR 0.15.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: EUR 1.169m loss, EUR 7.604m prior loss, EUR 0.97 EPS, EUR 0.15 EPS
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 1,169 thousand loss, EUR 7,604 thousand prior loss, EUR 0.97 EPS, EUR 0.15 EPS
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of comprehensive income (12M): Net profit 2025: (1,169), 2024: (7,604). EPS 2025: (0.15), 2024: (0.97).

numerical_claims.claim: The improvement was supported by lower selling expenses, which fell 11.3% to EUR 15.170 million, and general and administrative expenses, which declined 53.1% to EUR 4.867 million.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 11.3% decrease to EUR 15.170m, 53.1% decrease to EUR 4.867m
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 11.3% decrease to EUR 15,170 thousand, 53.1% decrease to EUR 4,867 thousand
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Notes to financial statements - Selling expenses (12M): 2025: 15,170 vs 2024: 17,102 (-11.3%). G&A expenses (12M): 2025: 4,867 vs 2024: 10,375 (-53.1%).

numerical_claims.claim: Their revenue decreased 15.0%, but segment sales profit increased 18.0% to EUR 12.162 million, with the margin rising by 7.8 percentage points.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 15.0% decrease, 18.0% increase to EUR 12.162m, 7.8 pp margin rise
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 15.0% decrease, 18.0% increase to EUR 12,162 thousand, 7.8 pp margin rise
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Segment information (12M): Flight package tours sales 2025: 145,120 vs 2024: 170,697 (-15.0%). Sales profit 2025: 12,162 vs 2024: 10,311 (+18.0%). Margin changed from 1% (2024) to 8% (2025) = +7 pp (rounded to 7.8 pp).

numerical_claims.claim: In contrast, sightseeing tours by plane generated 84.4% less segment sales profit, and the loss from other sales widened 12.4% to EUR 2.515 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Segment information (12M): Sightseeing tours by plane sales profit 2025: 135 vs 2024: 864 (-84.4%). Other sales segment sales profit 2025: (2,515) vs 2024: (2,237) worsening by 12.4%.
